# @arki/tanstack-start

> Shared TanStack Start wiring for Arki apps: router defaults, server entry, Sentry, PWA, devtools, Vite plugins, and typed oRPC client utils and hooks (keyset paging, optimistic mutations).

## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/tanstack-start`: @arki/tanstack-start. `AnalyticsScript`, `DevTools`, `RootErrorComponent`, `createAppConfig`, `createRouter`; types `AnalyticsConfig`, `AppConfig`, `DevToolsProps`, `RouterConfig`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/config`: TanStack Start App Configuration. `createAppConfig`, `defineConfig`; types `AppConfig`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/vite`: `fleetVite`, `oneChunkPerRoute`, `zodCompiled`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/server`: `startServer(app, { hot })` — the server entry of a Dot app on TanStack Start. `startServer`, `withForwardedProto`; types `StartHandler`, `StartServer`, `StartServerOptions`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/dot`: the `tanstackStart()` entrypoint plugin and the one-line server-route handlers. `TANSTACK_START_PLUGIN_ERROR_CODES`, `authHandlers`, `cronHandlers`, `healthHandlers`, `rpcHandlers`, `tanstackStart`; types `CorsOptions`, `CronRouter`, `MountOptions`, `RequestContextOf`, `TanstackStartOptions`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/router`: TanStack Router Configuration. `createQueryClient`, `createRouter`, `createTanStackRouter`; types `RouterConfig`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/orpc/client`: oRPC Client Setup for TanStack Start. `RPCLink`, `createORPCClient`, `createORPCReact`, `createOrpcUtils`, `createTanstackQueryUtils`, `getORPCUrl`; types `ORPCClientConfig`, `OrpcUtils`, `RouterClient`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/orpc/query`: typed React hooks over oRPC query utils. `keysetKey`, `keysetOptions`, `optimisticMutationOptions`, `useKeysetQuery`, `useOptimisticMutation`; types `Cache`, `KeysetOptions`, `KeysetResult`, `KeysetStatus`, `KeysetUtils`, `OptimisticContext`, `OptimisticOptions`; and 2 more.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/orpc/server`: oRPC Server Setup for TanStack Start. `RPCHandler`, `createORPCHandler`, `createRouteHandlers`, `createRouterClient`, `createServerCaller`, `getCorsHeaders`; types `ORPCServerConfig`, `RouterClient`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/scripts`: Analytics and Third-Party Script Components for TanStack Start. `AdsenseMeta`, `AnalyticsScript`, `AxiomScript`, `ContentSecurityPolicy`, `TurnstileScript`, `initClarity`, `initGoogleAnalytics`; types `AdsenseConfig`, `AnalyticsConfig`, `AxiomConfig`, `CSPConfig`, `TurnstileConfig`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/error`: `RootErrorComponent`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/devtools`: `DevTools`; types `DevToolsProps`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/sentry/client`: Browser-side Sentry initialization for TanStack Start apps. `Sentry`, `initSentryClient`; types `InitSentryClientOptions`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/sentry/server`: Server-side Sentry initialization for TanStack Start apps. `Sentry`, `initSentryServer`, `sentryGlobalFunctionMiddleware`, `sentryGlobalRequestMiddleware`, `wrapFetchWithSentry`, `wrapMiddlewaresWithSentry`; types `InitSentryServerOptions`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/sentry/bridge`: Zero-dependency bridge that lets shared package code call `captureException` without statically importing `@sentry/*`. `captureException`, `registerSentryCapture`; types `CaptureHandler`, `CaptureHint`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/server-error-overlay`: Server-side error overlay for TanStack Start `entry-server.ts`. `withServerErrorOverlay`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/pwa`: Configure `vite-plugin-pwa` for a TanStack Start app. `LAZY_CHUNK_IGNORES`, `MERMAID_DIAGRAM_IGNORES`, `SHIKI_LANG_IGNORES`, `SHIKI_THEME_IGNORES`, `createPwaPlugin`; types `CreatePwaPluginOptions`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/pwa/sw`: Shared service-worker base for TanStack Start apps. `setupOfflineNavigation`; types `OfflineNavigationOptions`.
- `@arki/tanstack-start/pwa/client`: Register the app's service worker. `clearCachesOnUserChange`, `registerPwa`, `registerStaleChunkReload`, `useClearCachesOnUserChange`; types `RegisterPwaOptions`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- Keep browser entries and Node entries apart. The `exports` map says which is which.
- The contract module given to `createOrpcUtils` must be browser-safe.
- `apply` in `useOptimisticMutation` is synchronous and only records edits.
- Sentry init runs before the router import.
- Sentry is opt-in by DSN.
